definition: Country where the study was conducted, as stated in the paper. If the paper does not name the country, write not reported (do not infer it).
Type and size of the hospital(s) and the wards/units covered by the study.
How widely the intervention was implemented.
Design of the evaluation, as you would classify it (not only the authors' label).
allowed_values: interrupted time series | controlled before-after | uncontrolled before-after | randomised trial | other

definition: Calendar period of the baseline and intervention phases.
Length of the intervention and follow-up period after the start of the intervention.
Is the intervention explicitly based on the WHO multimodal hand hygiene improvement strategy?
Components of the hand hygiene intervention.
allowed_values: list, separated by ';': education/training; alcohol-based hand rub at point of care; reminders/posters; audit and feedback; leadership/institutional safety climate; patient participation; other (specify)

definition: What the intervention period is compared with.
The main clinical healthcare-associated infection outcome reported (name it as the authors do).
Surveillance definition used for the infection outcome (e.g. CDC/NHSN), or not reported.
Unit in which the infection outcome is expressed.
Overall hand hygiene compliance at baseline (first or pre-intervention period), in %.
Overall hand hygiene compliance in the last intervention/follow-up period reported, in %.
Primary HAI outcome at baseline, in the unit given in outcome_denominator.
Primary HAI outcome in the last intervention/follow-up period reported, same unit.
Effect estimate for the primary HAI outcome with its 95% CI (e.g. IRR 0.85, 95% CI 0.79-0.90) or the statistical test reported.
Direction of the effect on the primary HAI outcome.
allowed_values: favourable | no clear effect | mixed | unfavourable

definition: Other infection prevention interventions running in the same period that could explain the outcome.
